offering_description.value: Verano is a vertically integrated US cannabis operator. It cultivates and manufactures cannabis flower, edibles, vapes and other products, and sells them through its own retail dispensaries to consumers and wholesale to other licensed retailers.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; vaporizer cartridges; edibles; concentrates; topicals

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult-use and medical cannabis patients and consumers buying at dispensaries; B2B: licensed third-party cannabis dispensaries buying wholesale

end_markets.value: adult-use cannabis; medical cannabis; consumer wellness

revenue_model.value: product sales: retail dispensary sales to consumers and wholesale sales of cannabis products to licensed retailers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: cultivates and processes cannabis into branded consumer products sold wholesale; retailer: operates company-branded dispensaries selling to consumers; brand owner: owns cannabis product brands sold through own and third-party stores

geography_served.value: US national: State-licensed operations in many states, e.g., Florida, Illinois, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Arizona, Maryland, Massachusetts, Nevada

specialization.value: related lines: cannabis cultivation, product manufacturing and retail dispensaries

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned retail dispensaries; distributors / dealers: wholesale to licensed third-party dispensaries

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state cannabis licensing, federal cannabis scheduling, state regulators, banking and tax restrictions

notes: State count and current federal scheduling status may have changed.
